problem: The static English cache validated successfully against source HTML, but the production build mutated/generated HTML before localized-route generation and introduced 1926 new strings. STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 therefore blocked every Netlify production build after generation.
root_cause: Cache completeness was validated against pre-build source while release enforcement happened against post-build generated markup. Those are different string universes, so cache completeness was not a stable production invariant.
prevention: STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE must not block publication when post-build generators introduce strings after cache validation.
Untranslated static English output is marked data-bg-static-translated=false and handed to the canonical runtime i18n fallback.
LIVE_BEWEZEN still requires the production browser verifier to navigate to /en/prijzen and assert visible English content.
